name: Osric Penn
description: A black armband. A good coat gone thin at the elbows. Holds his hat in both hands.

visits.greeting: I hope I'm not intruding. I wasn't sure who else to ask.

request.text: A preservation spell, if there is such a thing. My wife grew roses. I'd like to keep them as they are.

readThoughts.default: Her roses. Every one of them, just as she left them.

purpose.1: My wife's roses. She passed in the spring. They're the last thing of hers still growing.

knowledge.0: I don't know much about spells. I'm sorry.

experience.0: None. I kept the accounts; she kept the garden.

lent.line: Thank you. She would have liked you, I think.

offerRefused.line: Forgive me — I don't think that's the right sort of book.

walkedOut.line: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have come.

mixedAccident.text: The cut roses keep beautifully. They are on the table, where she liked them. I tried the other charm on her rosebush, the one by the door. It is very still now. I don't know if that is what I wanted. — Osric Penn

good.text: The roses keep beautifully. Thank you for your kindness. — Osric Penn
